summary: Alquileres: (1) Contrato cláusula CUARTA - verified via pypdf text extraction that PDF contains 'por la limpieza.' and the phrase 'si no se encontrara en perfecto estado' is gone. (2) New PATCH /api/rentals/reservations/{rid}/fechas: free move (noches recalculated, persisted, calendar updated, historial Check-in/Check-out with actor), self-overlap allowed, same dates no new historial, clash with other reservation -> 409 and nothing changed, clash with block -> 409, adjacent dates allowed, checkOut<=checkIn -> 400, unknown rid -> 404. UI (qa_varela login -> /veraos/alquileres/A161 -> tab Reservas -> Editar datos): date fields prefilled, clash shows 'Esas fechas ya no están disponibles.' inline and modal stays open, invalid range blocked client-side, free range saves and list row shows new dates + 5 noches; editing nombre/monto/deposito/limpieza without touching dates does NOT call /fechas and works as before, historial shows all 6 entries. Regression test_rentals_historial.py + test_rentals_geocoding.py pass. 19/20 backend tests pass; only failure is a malformed date returning 500.

minor.issue: Malformed date (e.g. checkIn='foo') returns 500 because date.fromisoformat raises ValueError in _nights(). The same thing happens in POST /reservations and /blocks. Should return 400/422. The UI uses type=date inputs, so the risk is low.

montoEstimado is not recalculated when the number of nights changes (3->5 noches kept $78.750). It may be intentional because the user can edit Importe total in the same modal, but consider a hint or auto-quote.
There is no check on estado: cancelled or finalized reservations and blocks can also be rescheduled. Consider restricting this.

integration_issues.issue: Saving is not atomic: if updateFechas succeeds and a later call (huesped/deposito/limpieza/monto) fails, the dates stay changed while an error is shown. Minor.

action_items: Optional: catch ValueError in _nights/_assert_free and return 400 for malformed dates
Optional: decide whether changing dates should recalculate montoEstimado or show a hint
Optional: block rescheduling of cancelada/finalizada reservations
critical_code_review_comments: routes_rentals.py update_fechas: no date format validation (str fields), leads to 500

update_fechas does not check estado; it allows moving canceled reservations into occupied ranges (canceled ones are not in OCUPA, but after the move they still don't occupy, so this is harmless but odd)
